data.problem: Understand how mcp_opencode_task is defined, how it spawns subagents, how results/progress flow back, and identify gaps in progress reporting.
constraints: No code or implementation in explore phase
Tool naming varies across MCP layers (task vs mcp_opencode_task vs mcp__opencode__task)
Subagent delegation is capped by config.experimental.max_delegation_depth
Permission rules can deny task delegation depending on agent config

options.name: Live trace a single Task invocation
options.approach: Run a controlled subagent task and observe tool name, metadata summary updates, and completion behavior in the session record.
options.what_we_learn: Actual runtime naming (mcp_opencode_task vs mcp__opencode__task), metadata update cadence, and completion signals.

options.name: Audit metadata consumption paths
options.approach: Locate where tool metadata/summary is rendered or used in UI/SDK to determine what progress is visible to users.
options.what_we_learn: Whether summary/sessionId data is surfaced and where progress reporting is currently limited.

options.name: Scope improvements to progress reporting
options.approach: Map required changes across TaskTool, SessionPrompt, and tool-bridge to add richer progress signals (text streaming, step events, explicit completion payloads).
options.what_we_learn: Exact integration points and complexity of closing current progress gaps.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it yields the fastest confirmation of naming, metadata, and completion behavior with minimal effort and no code changes.
